name: mast
description: Your phone buzzes until you acknowledge when Claude Code is blocked on you, finishes a long turn, or stops on an error. Also lets Claude page you on request, wait for your acknowledgement before continuing, and wire pager alerts into the apps it builds.

channel_url.title: Mast channel URL
channel_url.description: The send URL of a channel from the Mast app (https://mast.tissue.dev/mk_…). Environment variable MAST_CHANNEL_URL and ~/.config/mast/channel work too.
